title: The Magic Number Conjecture for k=2, m=4: computational proof certificates
description: Exact rational certificate data and deterministic replay tools accompanying Jack Tavakoli's existing k=2, m=4 Magic Number preprint. The supplement provides stable certificate IDs, a claim-to-certificate index, literal witnesses and matrices, exact verifiers, reproducibility instructions, and a hash manifest.
